name: 1:1 Personalised Sleep Coaching
description: This package helps you gain confidence in improving your little one's sleep, with follow-up WhatsApp support. Use your weekly check-ins however you like within 8 weeks. An AI-generated summary is also available on request.

name: The Village
description: This package gives you steady, long-term support for your child's sleep over 6 months. After your 1:1 consultation, you'll join The Village for daily guidance, learning from other parents, and optional weekly group coaching calls.

name: Sleep Overhaul
description: A complete sleep overhaul for determined parents. Over five weeks of 1:1 support, we address multiple sleep challenges, establish a routine that works for your family, and give you the confidence to manage future sleep changes.
